description.narrative: We will carry out a mapping of strengthening needs in public pedagogical institutes in two regions of the country, to learn more about the situation and challenges of these institutes. Then we will analyze experiences in strengthening capacities for in-service training of teachers, in alliance with key actors such as the KIPUS Network and the National Higher Pedagogical School of Monterrico, and considering the current in-service training guidelines. Based on these experiences and to address the main needs identified, a proposal for guidelines will be designed and validated - with key allies - to improve the capabilities of higher pedagogical institutes in terms of in-service training. The proposal must involve technical assistance to higher pedagogical institutes. We will implement the proposal in 10 higher pedagogical institutes to validate its effectiveness. The theory of change will seek to ensure that higher pedagogical institutes can receive technical assistance to improve their performance, focused on in-service teacher training. The identified needs may be addressed with technical assistance in 10 institutes to validate the effectiveness of the proposal. The sustainability of the proposal will be based on the participation of key allies, such as the KIPUS Network and the National Higher Pedagogical School of Monterrico, as well as the Ministry of Education and decentralized management bodies, which will have the proposal and its implementation recommendations. .
